_comment: EmberMC Pterodactyl egg. Published by TheMeanOneDevelopments under GPLv3. On install it downloads the latest EmberMC Paperclip build from cdn.emberplugins.online; the jar downloads the vanilla server from Mojang and patches it locally on first boot.
name: EmberMC
author: 187587479+TheUndeadKnightDev@users.noreply.github.com
description: EmberMC: a high-performance, GPLv3 Paper fork for large survival and economy networks. Runs every Paper plugin. Entity tiering, an always-on profiler, Packet Guard and an adaptive performance engine.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
apk add --no-cache curl jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

VERSION="${MC_VERSION}"
if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then VERSION="26.2"; fi

MANIFEST="https://cdn.emberplugins.online/embermc/versions.json"
URL=$(curl -s "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r --arg v "${VERSION}" '.versions[$v] as $ver | $ver.builds[($ver.latest|tostring)].download')

if [ -z "${URL}" ] || [ "${URL}" = "null" ]; then
  echo "Manifest lookup failed; using the pinned fallback."
  URL="https://cdn.emberplugins.online/embermc/embermc-26.2-1.jar"
fi

echo "Downloading EmberMC (${VERSION}) from ${URL}"
curl -s -L -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${URL}"
if [ -s "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then echo "EmberMC install complete."; else echo "EmberMC download failed."; exit 1; fi

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version to run. Use 'latest' for the newest EmberMC supports.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jarfile to run.
